# Everetts Place: Online Boutique

> Welcome to our online baby boutique, where your little one's comfort and the planet's health go hand in hand! We are proud to offer an exquisite selection of organic Muslin crib sheets that cradle your child in soft, breathable fabric, ensuring peaceful slumbers free from harmful chemicals. Our soy wax candles create a warm, inviting atmosphere in your home, emitting soothing scents without toxic additives, making them safe for both you and your baby.

## For Agents & Developers

This store supports the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) for programmatic commerce.

- Agent instructions: https://everetts.place/agents.md
- UCP discovery: https://everetts.place/.well-known/ucp
- MCP endpoint: https://everetts.place/api/ucp/mcp
- Product data: https://everetts.place/products/{handle}.json
- Collection data: https://everetts.place/collections/{handle}/products.json
- Storefront API: Available via Shopify (see https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront)
- Sitemap: https://everetts.place/sitemap.xml
- Robots.txt: https://everetts.place/robots.txt
